alignments.note: Finite verb; subject is the explicit noun Solomon.
Written 'to' goes to the לְ before the infinitive (rule 52).
Article on the toponym rectum; ASV writes no 'the' for the phrase (rule 29).
Supplied lexical subject noun (italic) answering to no morpheme (rule 17).
Niphal 'appeared'; the supplied subject 'Jehovah' is added separately.
Light verb plus complement 'made ready' heads on the complement (rule 44); subject pronoun with the verb (rule 17).

Rectum 'David' takes the relational 'that' the ASV writes for the construct relation (rule 19; margin 'in the place of David' read and set aside). The supplied verb is added separately, on the model of 'violence done to the land' (rule 20). Competing reading: whole 'that David had appointed' on the rectum.
Supplied lexical verb for a construct relation; no morpheme licenses it (rule 20).
'threshing floor' for גֹּרֶן heads on 'threshing' by rule 31's subtraction ('floor' alone is any floor); heading on 'floor' was available. Supplied 'the' joins the construct noun (rule 29).

review_notes: Supplied italic subject 'Jehovah' and supplied verb 'had appointed' marked added; margin gloss 'in the place of David' corroborates the construct reading.

alignments.note: The ASV reorders the two date phrases; this בְּ stands on 'month' and the English word standing before 'the second month' is 'of'. Competing reading: s005 → 'in' and s010 → 'of' by linear order.
Assimilated article takes the 'the' before its noun (rule 12).
Agreement article on the ordinal; single 'the' goes to the noun's article (rule 47).
Preposition on the substantival 'second [day]'; ASV's 'in' stands before that phrase (see s005 note).
Substantival ordinal completed with supplied 'day' (rule 31); head on the numeral.
Construct 'year' takes the supplied determiner (rule 15: the noun of the expression, not the numeral).

review_notes: ASV reverses the order of the month and day phrases; prepositions were aligned to the phrase each stands on rather than by linear order.

alignments.note: Hophal 'was founded' recast as noun plus relative clause 'the foundations which ... laid'; the whole recasting belongs to the verb (rule 46 closing paragraph), the copula from the construction (rule 20). Head on 'foundations', which carries the lexeme; 'laid' is not a supplied lexical verb since it restates יָסַד. Margin alternative read and set aside.
לְ before the gerund takes the written 'for' (rule 52).
Infinitive as gerund with its supplied 'the'.
Object marker takes the 'of' that attaches the object to the nominalized verb (rule 16).
Construct; the phrase's 'the' is fronted from the rectum's article (rule 29).
Article on anarthrous-rendered rectum takes the fronted 'the' (rule 29).
Bare measure nominal takes its supplied 'by' (rule 33).
Verbless clause; copula joins the predicate noun (rule 20). Competing placement: copula on the numeral.
Gapped copula not written by the ASV.

review_notes: הוּסַד recast as 'are the foundations which ... laid' kept as one unit on the verb; a noncompositional reading was available.

alignments.note: עַל־פְּנֵי fused as 'before' with the construction's copula (rule 30); head on the construct noun.
Italic 'the house' supplied as object of 'before'; the Hebrew has 'the length' there. One added unit (rule 2).
Supplied possessive 'of it' with no suffix present (rule 18 closing sentence).
Second עַל־פְּנֵי rendered 'according to'; fused (rule 30), head on 'according' (rule 24).
Construct takes supplied 'the'; the rectum is rendered arthrously (rule 29).
Copula from the construction joins the predicate noun (rule 20).
Indefinite article belongs to the numeral (rule 15).

Supplied 'with' reaching the bare material accusative זָהָב joins the verb (rule 44, as 'daubed ... with untempered mortar'); discontinuous around 'it within' (rule 25). Same reading as 3.5–3.10; rule 33 placement on the noun was the competing reading.
מִפְּנִימָה rendered by the single word 'within' (rule 30); head on the adverb.
Material noun keeps its own word; the 'with' is the verb's (rule 44).

review_notes: ASV 'before the house' supplies 'the house' where the Hebrew reads 'the length'; supplied words marked added rather than folded into הָאֹרֶךְ.
Reconciliation: 'with' moved from זָהָב to the verb's discontinuous unit (rule 44), bringing the verse into line with 3.5–3.10.

alignments.note: Bare object עֵץ reached through supplied 'with' → verb's unit (rule 44).
Rectum rendered attributively (rule 28); margin 'cypress-wood' set aside.

Waw of the clause recast as relative; the 'which' realizes the object suffix (rule 18), so the waw has no separate connective (rule 17). Competing reading: 'which' to the waw and the suffix unrepresented.
Supplied 'with' reaching bare object זָהָב joins the verb (rule 44).
Object suffix realized by the relative 'which' (rule 18).

review_notes: 'which' given to the object suffix rather than to the waw; the alternative is noted on both units.

alignments.note: Bare object אֶבֶן reached through supplied 'with' → verb (rule 44); discontinuous (rule 25).
Verbless clause; copula joins the predicate construct noun (rule 20).
Supplied 'with' reaching the bare object זָהָב joins the verb (rule 44); discontinuous.
Supplied 'the' joins the noun (rule 15); the suffix takes 'thereof'.
Construct 'house'; the chain is rendered attributively (rule 28).

The two קֹדֶשׁ nouns jointly render most holy. Their superlative construction supplies the degree, without a clearly preferable allocation of most to the second noun alone. The construct is the source anchor and holy the lexical target anchor.
Article on the innermost rectum takes the phrase's fronted 'the' (rule 29).
עַל־פְּנֵי fused as 'according to' (rule 30), head on 'according' (rule 24).
Construct takes supplied 'the'; rectum rendered arthrously (rule 29).
Supplied 'with' reaching bare object joins the verb (rule 44).
לְ of quantity rendered by the fixed phrase 'amounting to'; head on the content word (rule 24). Competing reading: 'amounting' added and only 'to' on the לְ.

review_notes: 'most holy' split between קֹדֶשׁ and הַקֳּדָשִׁים; 'amounting to' kept whole on the לְ.

alignments.note: Predicate לְ of the verbless clause takes the construction's copula (rule 49); its own relation unstated.
'upper chambers' for עֲלִיָּה heads on 'upper' (rule 31: 'chambers' alone is any chambers); heading on 'chambers' was available.
Supplied 'with' reaching bare object joins the verb (rule 44).

קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים has joint lexical ownership of most holy, with its article separately rendered outside this unit. The competing holy/most split assigns the construction's superlative force to one repeated noun without a clearly preferable basis.
Bare appositional nominal takes its supplied 'of' (rule 33).
Supplied 'with' reaching bare זָהָב joins the verb (rule 44).
Suffix left unrendered by the recasting; 'the wings' is the English subject.
Substantival numeral completed by italic 'cherub' (rule 31); 'of' the rectum's (rule 19).
Predicate לְ takes the construction's copula (rule 49).
Italic 'also'; the clause's waw already holds 'and' (rule 51).
Demonstrative takes the written 'these'; article unrepresented (rule 41).
Participle rendered 'spread themselves forth'; the reflexive and the particle complete the verb's own sense (rule 44).
Prepositional predicate takes the copula (rule 49); margin 'inward' set aside.
Bare material nominal takes its supplied 'of' (rule 33).
Bare measure nominal takes its supplied 'of' (rule 33); discontinuous around the numeral.
Suffix rendered by the distributive expansion 'of each of them'; whole expression realizes the suffix (rule 18), headed on the pronoun that realizes it (rule 19). Competing reading: 'each of' added.
Subject pronoun shared with the coordinated verb; no object morpheme.
Indefinite article belongs to the numeral (rule 15).
Supplied object pronoun with no object morpheme (rule 44).
Hiphil 'set up'; particle completes the lexeme (rule 44).
Anarthrous noun takes the supplied 'the' and the generic 'hand' (rules 15, 31); head on 'right'.
Second אֶחָד rendered 'the other'; supplied determiner joins it.
Substantival article takes the supplied pronoun 'that' (rule 41). Variant v001 underdetermined, r00-base retained; no exclusion marked.
Substantival adjective 'right-hand [one]' recast as 'on the right hand', with the rectum's 'of' (rule 19); head on 'right'. Competing reading: 'of that' on the article.
Substantival adjective recast as 'on the left' with the rectum's 'of' (rule 19); head on 'left'.

review_notes: Variant WLC.2CH.3.17.v001 (s021–s022) is underdetermined with the base reading retained and compatible with the English; no textual decision taken here. Margin glosses on the names read and set aside.

variant_decisions.evidence: Qere/ketiv orthographic variant of the same word 'the right' (הימני / הימיני); ASV 'on the right hand' renders both identically, no italic supply, and the two verse notes (Jachin, Boaz name glosses) are classed other and do not touch this word. Base qere fallback retained.
